## What lives here
The workflow planner's layers: decomposition, capabilities, execution modes, reuse, the data contract, design, provisioning, the tool gap, topology, data flow, input schema, oversight, rules, governance checks, finalisation (validate, save, compile, register) and verification (scenarios, dry run, repair).

## Conventions
Validation issues are routed back to the layer that owns them (`issue_owners`).

## Entry points
The workflow pipeline (`layers/__init__.py`), run by `workflow_plan` runs.
